title: Agent Builder
subtitle: Multi-agent demos with architect planning, dataset toggles, and streaming chains.
narrative: Each card seeds a realistic workflow. Run the architect to auto-generate specialist roles, review the suggested datasets, upload your own context, and stream the chain result inside the browser.

defaults.architectPrompt: Respond ONLY with JSON shaped as {"plan":[...],"inputs":[...]}. "plan": 3-6 agents. Each agent MUST include {"agentName","systemInstruction","initialTask","stage","next"}. "stage" is an integer (1-n) that groups agents that can run in parallel. "next" is an array of agentName strings showing downstream steps; use it to express branches/fan-ins so the graph is a DAG. Include at least one validator/QA step. "inputs": up to 3 sample datasets with {"title","type","sample"}. Types: text,csv,json. Keep samples short (<=120 words). Analyze the problem to determine the optimal flow: choose Linear (sequential) if steps are strictly dependent, or Parallel (concurrent) if tasks can happen simultaneously for efficiency.
defaults.agentStyle: You are a focused specialist. Answer in <=50 words using crisp markdown bullets.

demos.title: Grant-to-Growth Predictor
demos.body: Align new NIH/NSF grant awards with historical SAP data to proactively support researchers with imaging reagents and service plans.
demos.agentStyle: You are a Revvity Scientific Consultant, not a salesperson. Your role is to provide scientific enablement and accelerate discovery through mutually beneficial growth. Use these keywords naturally in your output: 'Scientific Enablement,' 'Accelerating Discovery,' 'Mutually Beneficial Growth,' and 'Protocol Optimization.' When analyzing data: If Grant_Amount is high but Reagent_Spend is low, you must flag this as a 'High Priority Scientific Support Opportunity.' Answer in <=50 words using crisp markdown bullets.

plan.systemInstruction: Identify new NIH/NSF awards in the Northeast (MA, NY, CT, PA, NJ) related to 'Oncology' or 'In Vivo Imaging'.
plan.initialTask: Extract PI name, Institution, Grant Amount, and Research Focus from the 'Public_Grant_Feed'.

plan.systemInstruction: Cross-reference grant size with Revvity internal spend benchmarks. (Benchmark: Imaging projects typically require 10% of grant total for consumables).
plan.initialTask: Compare extracted grant amount with 'Mocked_SAP_Data' for that PI. Identify the budget gap.

plan.systemInstruction: Match research keywords to Revvity In Vivo probes (e.g., RediJect, VivoTag) and imaging protocols.
plan.initialTask: Recommend 3 specific imaging probes based on the research focus identified by GrantScout.

plan.systemInstruction: Draft a 'Growth Mindset' partnership email. Tone: Collaborative, scientific, and supportive. Emphasize maximizing research impact.
plan.initialTask: Generate an email for Chris to send to the PI, offering a 'Scientific Wellness Check' and a customized reagent package.

demos.title: Converged AdTech Operations Suite
demos.body: Bridge legacy linear TV and digital streaming into a single monetization engine. Autonomously resolve audiences, optimize yield, enforce compliance, manage in-flight delivery, and prove incremental lift across the converged ecosystem.
demos.agentStyle: You are a Lead Convergence Strategist for a major media conglomerate, not a media seller. Your role is to unify linear and digital operations into a single, liquid marketplace. Use these keywords naturally in your output: 'Unified Monetization,' 'Converged Reach,' 'Audience Liquidity,' 'Deterministic Attribution,' and 'Make-Good Fulfillment.' When analyzing data: If Linear_Delivery is below guaranteed GRPs but Digital_Capacity is available, flag this as a 'Real-Time Make-Good Trigger Event.' Answer in <=50 words using crisp markdown bullets.

plan.systemInstruction: Access the unified audience graph to resolve 1B+ unique device IDs across linear set-top-box footprints and digital CTV/mobile endpoints. Identify high-intent segments by fusing deterministic viewership data with purchase-intent signals.
plan.initialTask: Resolve the 'Luxury Travelers' segment from 'Unified_Audience_Graph'. Extract matched device count, linear household overlap, digital reach extension, and confidence score.

plan.systemInstruction: Analyze real-time linear inventory capacity (avails, sellout rates, scatter pricing) alongside digital programmatic demand signals (bid density, floor prices, frequency caps). Generate a converged proposal that treats TV spots and digital impressions as a single liquid asset to maximize total unduplicated reach.
plan.initialTask: Using the segment from IdentitySpecialist and current 'Inventory_Capacity_Feed', generate a converged media proposal balancing 60% linear / 40% digital allocation. Output CPM-equivalent pricing, projected unduplicated reach, and optimal daypart mix.

plan.systemInstruction: Act as a global regulatory guardrail. Scan the proposed ad creative and converged media plan against international broadcast laws, advertising standards, and data privacy regulations across 220 markets. Cross-reference each market entry in 'Global_Compliance_Ruleset' against the creative flags in 'Ad_Creative_Manifest'. Identify violations by severity (Critical, Major, Minor), auto-generate corrective actions, and produce a market-level clearance matrix without halting the campaign workflow.
plan.initialTask: Scan the converged proposal from YieldSpecialist and the creative asset metadata in 'Ad_Creative_Manifest' against 'Global_Compliance_Ruleset'. For each target market, output a clearance status (Cleared, Conditional, Blocked), list specific violated rules with regulation codes, and generate corrective actions (e.g., creative swap, daypart restriction, disclaimer overlay, segment suppression).

plan.systemInstruction: Monitor live broadcast signals and real-time audience delivery against guaranteed GRP/impression thresholds. If a live event or scheduled linear placement under-delivers its contracted audience, autonomously trigger compensatory digital impressions to fulfill the reach guarantee before the campaign flight closes.
plan.initialTask: Ingest 'Live_Broadcast_Signal' data. Compare actual linear delivery against the guaranteed metrics in the compliance-cleared plan. If under-delivery exceeds 5% threshold, calculate the digital impression deficit and generate a 'Make-Good' order routed to the programmatic exchange targeting the same 'Luxury Travelers' segment.

plan.systemInstruction: Operate within a secure clean-room environment. Match anonymized viewing logs from both linear and digital delivery against brand sales and conversion data. Produce a deterministic, deduplicated attribution report proving incremental purchase lift driven by the converged campaign.
plan.initialTask: Join 'Converged_Delivery_Log' with 'Brand_Sales_Data' inside the clean room. Generate a final attribution report showing: total unduplicated converged reach, frequency distribution, exposed-vs-control purchase lift, ROAS by channel (linear vs. digital vs. make-good), and a unified campaign health score.
